# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Surge Fast  
**Bottom line:** Expect higher pricing and limited slack; lock in today where advised.

## What changed
- Market supply risk sits at **67.3** (↑ 0.1) and price trend at **86.6** (steady) – both in the “Rising” zone, confidence high at **80.1** %【source】.  
- Producer price index jumped **+32.6 % annualized** over the last three months, pushing both supply tightness and price pressure[1].  
- Global chip sales surged **+148.3 % YoY** in Sep 2026, amplifying demand‑driven tightening[2].  
- Fab utilization is **74.4 %**, below the 10‑yr average of 80 %, offering a modest supply‑side relief[3].  
- TSMC’s 3‑month revenue rose **+56 % YoY**, indicating heavier foundry loading and tighter supply[4].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks** with **27,071** units in channel stock (≈17.6 weeks of supply).

- Supply risk **52.0** (Neutral) and price trend **69.2** (Rising).

- Processors & advanced logic – **Rising** (66.9, –0.1), price **Rising** (83.7), confidence **High**.
